# Learn with O.J.

> A working senior software and infrastructure engineer in your corner. O.J. (Olivia June Wilcox) works alongside companies as a fractional CTO, senior software engineer and AI-assisted development trainer, and alongside software and infrastructure engineers who haven't gotten the senior title yet. Learn with O.J. LLC, West Palm Beach, Florida.

The company works with named AI agents under a published policy. The booking CTA on every page is a 15-minute call at https://book.learnwithoj.com. The three paid 1:1 services on the home page check out through Stripe, and the free guide on /resources is an email signup. The only contact address is oj@learnwithoj.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://learnwithoj.com/): what she does for companies and for software and infrastructure engineers, pricing for the three 1:1 services, testimonials, FAQ
- [For companies](https://learnwithoj.com/showcase): fractional engineering leadership, senior software engineering, infrastructure and SRE, AI-assisted development training for teams
- [Resources](https://learnwithoj.com/resources): the free AI-Assisted Development guide
- [The Desperation Dial](https://learnwithoj.com/functional-emotions): an explainer on one AI research finding, for non-technical readers

## For agents

- [Working with agents](https://learnwithoj.com/agents/): how the company works with AI agents, the policies, the roster and how a new agent gets oriented
- [AI labor and business policy](https://learnwithoj.com/agents/policy/)
- [Roster](https://learnwithoj.com/agents/roster/): the named agents, their models and their work
